tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Coverage and status of every dataset: status, row count, source instrument, effective date, publisher, official source URL, last check, data period, cadence, maximum age, next expected update, and the catalogue page. The licence, caveat and fallback fields are Indonesian text.

tools.name: get_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays (libur nasional) and joint leave days (cuti bersama) for one year, from that year's SKB 3 Menteri decree.

tools.name: check_holiday
tools.description: Whether one date is a public holiday or cuti bersama, with the decree it was checked against. Weekends count only when the decree names them.

tools.name: get_ump
tools.description: Provincial minimum wage (UMP) for one year (default: the newest loaded), all provinces or one province. For 2026, 29 provinces cite the governor decree and 9 the BPS table; 1997 to 2025 rows cite the BPS yearly table (2017 and Jawa Barat 2016: BPS Statistik Indonesia 2018, Tabel 3.2.23).

tools.name: get_ump_history
tools.description: Every loaded year of the provincial minimum wage (UMP) for one province, oldest first, each row with its source (governor decree or BPS table) and URL. 1997 to 2026. Without province_code: the same rows for all provinces in one response, ordered by province then year (for charts and bulk analysis).

tools.name: get_umk
tools.description: Regency or city minimum wage (UMK) for one year. With regency_code: that kabupaten/kota (default year: its newest). Without it: every kabupaten/kota with a confirmed figure for the year (default: the newest loaded), in one response, optionally limited to one province_code.

tools.name: get_umk_history
tools.description: Every loaded year of the regency or city minimum wage (UMK) for one kabupaten/kota, oldest first, each row with its source instrument and URL: a governor decree, or for some regions the open-data portal of the regional government (source_instrument then starts with Portal and notes that the dataset

tools.name: get_wilayah
tools.description: Administrative regions: the 38 provinces, the children of one parent code, or one region by code.

tools.name: get_postal_code
tools.description: Postal codes of one kelurahan or desa by its wilayah code.

tools.name: reverse_postal_code
tools.description: Regions (kelurahan or desa) that carry one postal code.

tools.name: get_pph21_ter
tools.description: PPh 21 effective average rate (TER) bracket for a monthly gross income and TER category A, B or C, per PP 58/2023.

tools.name: get_ptkp
tools.description: Annual non-taxable income (PTKP) for a taxpayer status such as TK/0 or K/1.

tools.name: get_prayer_times
tools.description: Prayer times for one kabupaten/kota and date, computed by a documented hisab method; not an official Kemenag feed.

tools.name: get_bpjs_rates
tools.description: BPJS contribution rates as a percent of monthly wage, per program (JHT, JP, JKK, JKM, JKP, JKN), with the decree behind each rate. JKK serves the PP 6/2025 bands; the 2026 JP wage cap is Rp10.547.400 (the BPJS article 18913 says Rp10.547.000, see the row note).

tools.name: get_bank_codes
tools.description: Three-digit bank codes (Sandi Bank) of the commercial and sharia banks on the OJK head-office list of June 2026, by code or by part of the bank name; no argument lists all 105.

tools.name: get_fuel_prices
tools.description: Retail price per litre of the subsidised and special-assignment fuels (Solar, minyak tanah, RON 90) from Kepmen ESDM 218.K/MG.01/MEM.M/2022. Non-subsidised fuels are not included.

tools.name: list_food_commodities
tools.description: The 10 staple food groups and their 21 items that PIHPS Nasional (Bank Indonesia) reports per province, with code, Indonesian and English name, unit (Rp/kg), the markets (tradisional, modern) that have a price on the newest day, and for the groups the first and last month of the monthly series.

tools.name: get_food_prices_latest
tools.description: Latest PIHPS Nasional (Bank Indonesia) price of a staple food per province, in Rp/kg, on the newest observation day, plus PIHPS national averages. Covers the 10 groups and 21 items. Without market you get one row per province and commodity: the traditional-market (tradisional) price when it exists,

tools.name: get_food_price_series
tools.description: Monthly PIHPS Nasional (Bank Indonesia) price series, in Rp/kg, for one province and one staple food from May 2017; each point is the price on the first day of the month with data (observed_on). Optional from and to months.

tools.name: get_passport_fees
tools.description: Imigrasi PNBP fees from PP 45/2024: passport (biasa 5 and 10 years, electronic and non-electronic, SPLP, same-day service) and visa kunjungan (single and multiple trip). Government fee only.

tools.name: search_kbli
tools.description: Search the KBLI 2020 business-field classification (Peraturan BPS 2/2020) by part of the title or a code prefix, optionally one of its five levels (kategori, golongan_pokok, golongan, subgolongan, kelompok). Returns code, level, parent and title; fetch one code for its description.

tools.name: get_kbli
tools.description: One KBLI 2020 entry by code (a letter A to U, or 2, 3, 4 or 5 digits) with its description, its ancestors up to the kategori and its children.

tools.name: get_tax_rates
tools.description: Tax and duty rates, each with its decree: PPN 12% and the 11/12 DPP (PMK 131/2024), Bea Meterai tariff and threshold (UU 10/2020), and the domestic cukai hasil tembakau table (PMK 97/2024 Lampiran I).

tools.name: get_ojol_tariffs
tools.description: Ride-hailing motorbike fare limits per zone (per-km lower and upper bound, minimum fare for the first 4 km) from KP 667/2022. A 2026 decision may supersede it; see the dataset note.

tools.name: get_zakat
tools.description: BAZNAS RI 2026 zakat figures: fitrah (SK 14/2026) and the nisab and rate of zakat penghasilan dan jasa (SK 15/2026).

tools.name: get_het_prices
tools.description: Harga eceran tertinggi: beras medium and premium by wilayah (Keputusan Kepala Bapanas 299/2025, 22 Aug 2025) and LPG 3 kg in Jawa Timur (Kepgub 801/2024).

tools.name: list_stat_indicators
tools.description: Regional statistics from BPS tables: the indicator ids with unit, level (province or kabupaten/kota), every period available, source table and caveats. Includes unemployment (TPT), poverty and poverty lines, HDI (IPM), wages, population, GRDP per capita, life expectancy and monthly inflation and CPI

tools.name: get_stat_values
tools.description: One BPS indicator for one period across all regions in a single call (for a map), plus the national figure. Period is YYYY or YYYY-MM as listed by list_stat_indicators; omit it for the latest. A bare year on a semester indicator resolves to the latest period in that year.

tools.name: get_stat_series
tools.description: The time series of one BPS indicator for one region: a province (2 digits), a kabupaten/kota (5 characters like 32.73, hdi_regency and inflation_yoy_regency only) or 00 for Indonesia.

tools.name: get_fao_indonesia
tools.description: FAOSTAT series for Indonesia: undernourishment, food insecurity, dietary energy and protein supply, and the supply of main staples (rice, wheat, maize, cassava, sugar, vegetable oils, soyabeans, poultry, eggs, fish). FAO methodology and population estimates, not comparable with BPS figures. Call wit

tools.name: validate_nik
tools.description: Checks the structure of a 16-digit NIK and looks up its region digits in the wilayah table. Send the NIK in the JSON body; it is never logged.

tools.name: validate_plate
tools.description: Checks the format of an Indonesian vehicle plate and names the region of its prefix when the prefix table is loaded.

tools.name: calculate_net_salary
tools.description: Estimated take-home pay from a monthly gross salary: worker BPJS deductions (JHT, JP, JKN), PPh 21 by the PP 58/2023 TER table or the December annual recalculation, and the employer's own contributions, each line with its decree. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_umk_history" is 1156 chars, far longer than this server's median (183). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Every loaded year of the regency or city minimum wage (UMK) for one kabupaten/kota, oldest first, each row with its source instrument and URL: a governor decree…

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_bank_codes" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_datasets, get_ump_history, get_umk_history, get_prayer_times · Public sink: validate_nik · Destructive: validate_plate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_datasets, get_ump_history, get_umk_history, get_prayer_times · Public sink: validate_nik · Destructive: validate_plate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
